say:1:1430104401:1.text: What else could it be? All their little plans they have going on.
say:1:1430104401:1.source_cn: 还能是什么，自然是他们干的那些“好事”。

say:2:1430104402:1.text: They're worried every day, wondering what kind of news the Lightbearer will report back with...
say:2:1430104402:1.source_cn: 他们现在每天忧心忡忡，猜测耀光那边会传回怎样的消息……

say:3:1430104403:1.text: What's the worst that could happen? Instead of worrying every day, it's better to eat, drink, and relax.
say:3:1430104403:1.source_cn: 要我说最坏能到哪里去？与其每天忧心，不如吃好喝好等通知！
